svg.title: SensAI
svg.desc: Top 5 of about 100 teams at the HyperVerge GenAI Hackathon. Built in 36 hours by a team of two who learned generative AI on the spot. Turns an idea or a PDF into a full course. FastAPI, Next.js, WebSockets.
